title: Dissappoinment in a box (size 50lb+)
text: I was interested to see what I would get with this box because bully sticks are expensive as well to try other products. I received two very thin bully sticks, terrible quality, not like pawstruck at all! There is a back strap chew maybe, not sure, in the bag with the two bully springs. I also received a bag of cow ears, 2 pig ears, one yak cheese chew (not sure I trust it as it looks frail and is already coming apart in chunks that look sharp) and one bleached white bone filled with something. I will not feed the bone as it looks bleached to get that white and the stuff inside smells awful and moldy. Very disappointed in Pawstruck, this could have been a great investment. For reference I bought the 50lb+ box on sale well before Christmas. I didnt receive it till after Christmas though. So do not expect speedy shipping either.
label: negative
